name: Can I finance an ADU project, and what are the options available?

mainEntity.name: Can I finance an ADU project, and what are the options available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, several financing options are available for ADU projects. These may include home equity loans, home equity lines of credit (HELOCs), construction loans, or cash-out refinances. Some lenders also offer specific ADU financing products. Eligibility and interest rates typically depend on your credit score, home equity, and debt-to-income ratio. It is advisable to explore options with financial institutions.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADU projects can be financed through home equity loans, HELOCs, construction loans, or cash-out refinances. Options depend on credit and equity.
